display_long_description:
An inexplicable portal has appeared, devouring nearby plants and trees. Countless infected skeletons and monsters pour out, targeting the island’s "Guardian Stone Tablet"—if destroyed, the whole island will be fully shrouded in plague.
So far, the plague has eroded several islands and is still spreading. Now, a border village sends a distress signal: the plague portal has opened, and infected creatures may invade anytime. Its Guardian Stone Tablet needs your protection.
You’ll play as an island magic tower defender, using a bow and arrow and a magical sand table to fend off enemies.

# Magical Sand Table: Virtual-Real Intertwine

Control a strategic sand table—your layouts/deductions map real-time to the game world. Place defense towers on it (1:1 with in-game map); same towers rise in real scenes to block enemies.
[media]

# Dual-Front Combat: Stirring Strategy
You need to plan overall and arrange arrow towers/fortifications, and can also draw a bow to shoot precisely. Enjoy the dual fun of strategic layout and action.

[media]

# Free Shooting Range: Do as You Wish

It’s a training camp to hone archery and test new weapons, plus a safe space for free movement, exploration and surprise discovery—offering relaxation amid intense battles.
[media]

# Player Command Room: Strategy Hub

Unlocked in-game trophies are displayed too, recording your gaming journey.
[media]
